seed: The first drag of a component off the shelf used to land the ORIGINAL, and every drag after it landed a copy, so what you clicked depended on history nobody could see: one Button on a fresh document, clicked, gave the whole authoring wall. Every drag lands a copy now, and the original comes in beside it, clear of the drop. This walk drops one and reads back both panels.

steps.note: the FIRST drag lands a COPY, picked, and its panel is the short one: which look it shows and a value per property, with no Name field, no sharing switch and no Add

steps.says: The original of Button arrived beside it

steps.note: the way back to the original is one move, and the original's panel is the long one: it still shows everything it showed before
a second drag reads exactly the same as the first: another copy, still one original
